compiled_state.description:
## Purpose

Prepare and execute safe remediation of the pre-existing tickets-store fsck baseline discovered after tickets commit `f2837f0a8`: 550 `SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL`, 10 `ORPHAN_EVENT`, plus 1 initially visible `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` audit finding; the repair rehearsal exposed 3 additional intentional records hidden by stale snapshots. Run the authoritative repair during the same quiet maintenance window as epic child `561e-e186-a902-461c`, before the history rewrite.

Literal fsck-zero is not the contract: `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` is permanent derived audit evidence deliberately surfaced by `fsck` and `show`. Success means zero repairable integrity findings, with the exact four acknowledged resolved-fork audit records retained: `4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, and `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f`.

## Pre-window preparation

1. From a fresh unfiltered throwaway clone of the current `origin/tickets` tip, capture `rebar fsck --output json` as a manifest containing the tip SHA, counts by kind, ticket IDs, filenames, orphan event types, plus preimage hashes. This clone is disposable and must never push.
2. Classify every `ORPHAN_EVENT` using the code-owned AUTO-RECOVER versus HUMAN-TRIAGE sets. Record an explicit disposition for every orphan. A human-triage orphan is never rebuilt implicitly.
3. Verify the already-landed safety tooling from Gerrit change 1391 rather than rebuilding it. The landed implementation adds `SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL` as a bucket in `_repair_plan` and exposes `rebar fsck --repair --only=stale-channel` through `_repair_run`. `_repair_run(only=None)` plus `_repair_ticket(repair_stale_channel=False)` preserve the existing retire/orphan inclusion and rebuild predicates; `only="stale-channel"` switches selection and rebuild to the stale-channel bucket and refuses mixed `SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT` or `ORPHAN_EVENT` faults before mutation. The shared retained-CREATE/stale-channel predicate now lives in `fsck_repair.py` and is imported by `fsck.py`, preserving the documented one-way diagnostic-to-repair dependency. Focused tests and the disposable/live receipts verify these landed behaviors; no duplicate implementation remains.
4. Verify backward compatibility in the landed implementation: `rebar fsck --repair` is unchanged when `--only` is absent; `--repair-snapshots` remains the documented broad, unbatched, non-pushing surface; the narrow selector is the authoritative live-store path; and unknown `--only` values plus `--only` without `--repair` exit 2 with operator-readable errors.
5. Rehearse the exact class-scoped repair in a throwaway repository with a disposable bare remote. Prove dry-run immutability, batching/resumability, push-failure abort, mixed-fault refusal, rollback to the pre-tag, plus the expected four-record residual audit set.
6. Rehearse the combined sequence against the disposable repaired tip: verified off-repo bundle, reclaim helper, tree/count/identity/pack assertions, exact force-with-lease to the disposable remote, rollback from the bundle, then restored identity-boundary verification. Record runtimes plus disk requirements.
7. Confirm the safety tooling landed through normal Gerrit review before live execution. Gerrit change 1391, patchset 4, commit `f82b2afae75827f8aa4e80af47cead5da96feb71` is MERGED with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`; the ticket remained open until the quiet-window repair criteria were satisfied.

## Measured preparation census

At unfiltered clone tip `018ac519498af1890a2af07a2a4291630ec4af9d`, `size-pack` is 1.89 GiB and fsck reports exactly 561 findings: 550 stale-channel, 10 orphan-event, plus 1 resolved-fork audit finding. All 10 orphans are `LINK` events, so every one is AUTO-RECOVER under the code-owned disposition set; there are zero HUMAN-TRIAGE orphans. The 10 events span 9 tickets. Eight of those tickets are mixed stale-channel/orphan cases, so the existing AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair must run first. The ninth orphan ticket is orphan-only. Ticket `4214-ac28-d19c-41b9` is mixed stale-channel/resolved-fork; rebuilding its stale snapshot must preserve the derived audit finding.

## Quiet-window execution

1. After explicit operator confirmation of zero active sessions plus stopped `rebar-mcp` servers, revalidate every A6-1 writer pause and queue check.
2. Converge the shared tracker to the exact live `origin/tickets` tip. Capture a fresh JSON diagnostic manifest. Compare it to the rehearsal manifest; any new kind, new orphan, mixed-fault ticket, or changed preimage requires re-triage before mutation.
3. Create and verify the pre-repair off-repo bundle required by child `561e`.
4. Run the existing AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair path first in resumable batches. The current manifest contains exactly 10 `LINK` orphans and zero HUMAN-TRIAGE orphans; any drift from that set aborts before mutation. Require every batch commit plus push to succeed.
5. Run `rebar fsck --repair --only=stale-channel --limit=200` in resumable batches until no stale-channel finding remains. The mixed stale/orphan tickets must have become stale-only or clean after step 4; any remaining mixed-fault refusal aborts for re-triage. Require every batch commit plus push to succeed.
6. Run a fresh read-only fsck report. Require zero `SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL`, zero `SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT`, zero `ORPHAN_EVENT`, zero missing/corrupt findings, plus exactly the four recorded `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` audit records on `4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, and `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f`.
7. Record before/after counts, exact repair commits, push receipts, elapsed time, plus the execution order on this ticket and child `561e`. Continue into the final post-repair backup and reclaim only after these assertions pass.

## Rollback

Before live mutation, retain the verified off-repo bundle and the exact pre-repair tip. If any batch or post-repair assertion fails, keep writers paused, restore the old tip from the verified bundle with exact `--force-with-lease=<failed-tip>:<old-tip>`, re-converge all consumers, then confirm the original diagnostic manifest plus identity receipt before deciding whether to retry. Never use an application merge to roll back across epochs.

## Acceptance Criteria

The code-verifiable items below verify the already-landed Gerrit 1391 behavior; they are not instructions to rebuild that functionality.

- [ ] [code-verifiable] `fsck --repair --only=stale-channel` selects only stale-channel snapshots.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A stale-channel ticket with any snapshot inconsistency or orphan finding is refused before mutation.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Dry-run reports the exact selected tickets with zero file writes.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Dry-run creates zero commits.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `--limit=N` makes the stale-channel repair resumable by ticket count.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Each live batch commits plus pushes through the existing repair path.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A push failure aborts before any later batch.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Unknown `--only` values exit 2 with an operator-readable error.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `--only` without `--repair` exits 2 with an operator-readable error.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Existing unfiltered `fsck --repair` behavior is unchanged.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Help plus CLI reference document the narrow mode and mixed-fault refusal.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The pre-window manifest records every current diagnostic with exact ticket/filename/type.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Every current orphan has an AUTO-RECOVER or HUMAN-TRIAGE disposition.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The disposable repair rehearsal residual resolved-fork ticket-ID set equals {`4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f`}.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The disposable rollback restores the exact pre-repair tip plus diagnostic manifest.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The disposable combined reclaim rehearsal passes tree/count/identity/pack/non-resurrection assertions.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The safety-tooling Gerrit change lands with both required positive votes.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Quiet-window stale-channel count is zero after repair.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Quiet-window orphan count is zero after repair.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Quiet-window missing/corrupt diagnostic count is zero after repair.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The visible `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` ticket-ID set equals {`4214-ac28-d19c-41b9`, `72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b`, `b043-9490-32ca-4548`, `fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f`}.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Before/after counts plus repair commit SHAs are recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The repair-to-reclaim execution order is recorded on this ticket plus child `561e`.

## Scope

Landed code verification target: `src/rebar/_commands/fsck.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/fsck_repair.py`, CLI help/reference, focused interface/integration tests. Operational: disposable clones during preparation; the authoritative tickets store only after the explicit quiet-window confirmation. No shared-main-checkout mutation.

Execution update: Gerrit 1391 supplied the only code delta; all remaining work under this plan was verification and the quiet-window repair.
